overview: Solomon Islands is a country of almost a thousand islands in the South Pacific, east of Papua New Guinea. Its capital, Honiara, is on the island of Guadalcanal, scene of major battles in the Second World War. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1978. Dozens of local languages are spoken, and Solomon Islands Pijin is widely used.

geography.text: The main islands are rugged, volcanic and covered in rainforest, while many smaller islands are low coral atolls. Marovo Lagoon is one of the largest saltwater lagoons in the world, and East Rennell, on the island of Rennell, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

history.text: The Solomon Islands were settled tens of thousands of years ago. Britain declared a protectorate over them in the 1890s. Guadalcanal saw some of the fiercest fighting of the Second World War in 1942 and 1943. The country became independent in 1978, and a period of ethnic unrest from 1998 to 2003 ended with help from an Australian-led regional mission.

events.title: Regional mission
events.text: An Australian-led mission helps restore order.

government.text: Solomon Islands is a constitutional monarchy within the Commonwealth. The British monarch is head of state, represented by a Governor-General. The Prime Minister leads the government with the support of the National Parliament.

economy.text: Most people live by farming and fishing. Timber is the biggest export, along with fish, palm oil and cocoa. China has become a major partner.

culture.text: The country is made up of nearly 1,000 islands and more than 60 languages; Solomon Islands Pijin is the common language. Shell money, strings of small shell discs, is still used in traditional exchanges such as marriages.

items.title: Shell money
items.text: Strings of shell beads used in traditional ceremonies.

items.title: Skull Island
items.text: A shrine of chiefs' skulls in the Western Province.

sport.text: Football is the most popular sport, and Solomon Islands is one of the strongest football and futsal nations in the Pacific. Honiara hosted the Pacific Games in 2023.

items.title: Futsal
items.text: The Kurukuru team is one of the best in Oceania.

didYouKnow: Guadalcanal was the site of a major Second World War battle in 1942–43.
